changed.282: “Starting with your eyes open, press your thumb to your forefinger, gently, and let go. Each time you do, you get a little more awake… Press and let go again, a bit clearer. And once more, and now you’re clearer than when you started. Now stop pressing. In the first second after you stop, is the pressing still echoing somewhere? Start with your fingers, which may still be tingling. Next, see if your breath kept the rhythm going. Then check whether your attention is still waiting for the next press. Or maybe there’s no echo at all. Just notice, sit up straight and work from this level.”

changed.528: To 'Milton Model' is to open things up, so the listener can fill in what fits for them. To 'Meta Model' is to stop and ask, "What do you mean by that?" In order to be ethical with people, you need to do both.
